title: Rogue Process / Mining Triage: 100% GPU at Idle
symptom: My laptop fans are screaming at maximum speed and GPU usage is pinned at 99% according to Task Manager, even though I am sitting idle on the desktop with no games open after downloading a file.

expected_output.symptom_summary: GPU experiences unexpected 99% compute utilization and maximum fan RPM during idle desktop state following a recent file download.

evidence.text: fans are screaming at maximum speed
GPU usage is pinned at 99% according to Task Manager
sitting idle on the desktop with no games open after downloading a file

possible_causes.cause: Unauthorized background compute payload (such as a stealth cryptocurrency miner or CUDA compute process) masquerading as a system service.
possible_causes.verification: Open Task Manager Processes tab, sort by GPU engine column, and check command line parameters for suspicious executables in AppData/Temp.

possible_causes.cause: Corrupted graphics driver state causing the GPU power state (P-State) to lock at full 3D clocks (P0) without downclocking.
possible_causes.verification: Check GPU core clock in GPU-Z or HWiNFO; verify if clock drops after pressing Win+Ctrl+Shift+B to reset the display driver.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Open Windows Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc), navigate to Details tab, right click columns and enable 'GPU', then sort descending to identify the exact PID consuming the GPU.
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: Directly identifies the specific executable process causing the compute load.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Right-click the suspicious high-GPU process and select 'Open file location' before terminating it.
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: Locates the file path (often hidden in `%APPDATA%` or `%TEMP%`) to prevent automatic persistence on reboot.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Disconnect Wi-Fi / Ethernet temporarily and observe if GPU usage immediately drops to 0%.
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: Unauthorized mining malware often terminates or idles when network communication with the mining pool is cut.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Run a full scan with Windows Defender Offline to purge any scheduled startup persistence tasks.
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: Ensures registry Run keys and Scheduled Tasks are remediated safely.
